name: Merry X'mas You, for Your Closed World, and You…
source:
Without the right background assets, he can't leave the school. 
No character art for guys means no male characters showing up. 
The heroines act like they barely have brains, just regurgitating cliché lines. 
The script is sloppy as hell. 
And our guy has some absurdly convenient plot devices work in his favor. Btw, the setting itself is just plain stupid.

Our main dude realizes he's stuck being the main character in this lame excuse of a story. 
He’s both the hero and an audience member, watching his own shenanigans while eating popcorn.
If there's any hint at a plot twist, he figures it out before it’s revealed, even laying down hypotheses,
and ultimately ends up spoiling everything. 
At such times, with a disappointed sigh, he mutters, "That's it?"

Trapped in school without a soul to talk to, 
he's suffocated by the oppressiveness in the air. 
The world's functioning seems ruled by a single higher dimensional force. 
The puppet strings held by the author (aka God) can be seen with a naked eye. 
But, nonetheless, our guy fights tooth and nail against that reality.

[Translated from [url=https://aeb.iinaa.net/merry.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
没有合适的背景素材，他就无法离开学校。
没有男性角色立绘，就不会有任何男性角色登场。
女主角们的脑子像是几乎不会思考，只会把陈词滥调的台词机械地重复出来。
剧本粗制滥造得要命。
而且，我们的男主角还有一些荒谬却恰到好处的剧情便利。
顺便一提，这个设定本身就蠢得离谱。

我们的男主角意识到，自己被困在这部蹩脚故事里，只能扮演主角。
他既是英雄，也是观众，一边吃着爆米花，一边看着自己胡闹。
每当剧情有任何暗示要出现反转，他都会在真相揭晓前就猜到，甚至先提出假设，
最后干脆把一切都剧透了。
这种时候，他会失望地叹气，喃喃道：“就这？”

被困在学校里、身边没有一个可以交谈的人，他被空气中的压迫感憋得喘不过气。
这个世界的运行方式，仿佛由某种更高维度的力量支配。
作者（也就是上帝）操纵的提线已清晰可见。
然而，我们的男主角仍然拼尽全力与这份现实抗争。

[译自[url=https://aeb.iinaa.net/merry.html]官方网站[/url]]
